answer: The beacon edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 12 clones produces a signature the grove analysis flags immediately. An copycat must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the knoll settlement applies the void retroactively. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
